active_family: anchored recent-window FM adaptation under test
current_bottleneck: The current best remains full recent-window adaptation 377a at 8/11. A simple checkpoint anchor does not solve the tradeoff: stronger anchoring preserves capacity but loses conditionality and still leaves coverage/regime/distribution failures.
last_result_summary: 382a added optional weight-space anchoring to the 377a recent FM adaptation trainer. A pilot anchor_weight=0.1 was too weak by loss scale. Official evaluation of anchor_weight=1.0 scored 7/11, failing coverage, conditionality, regime_coverage, and distributional_fidelity. It had MAE reduction 3.56%, level KS 9/25, median-bias fraction 18/25, regime layer2 0/8, and cointegration passed.
next_step_recommendation: Run post-experiment analysis before adding another knob. The evidence now shows three clean adaptation variants all fail differently: full adaptation gets 8/11 but drifts level law; freezing improves level KS but loses conditionality/cointegration; anchoring loses conditionality without enough distributional gain. The next move should isolate whether the remaining failures are caused by validation endpoint level drift, per-cell heteroskedastic width geometry, or sample-count/test instability.
